title: Azure Service Operator
description: Health, reconciliation activity, and Azure Resource Manager traffic for Azure Service Operator v2.

list.name: job
list.label: Job
list.description: Prometheus job that scrapes the ASO controller. A Prometheus Operator ServiceMonitor for ASO's metrics service produces the default value.

list.name: controller
list.label: Controller
list.description: ASO runs one controller per resource kind.

panels.title: Reconciles / s
panels.description: Rate of reconciliations across the selected controllers.

panels.title: Azure request error ratio
panels.description: Share of requests to Azure Resource Manager that failed: requests with no response plus 4xx/5xx responses. 404 responses are excluded because ASO routinely receives them when checking whether a resource exists before creating it. ASO records most reconcile failures on each resource's Ready condition rather than as reconcile errors, so this is the best metric-based signal that resources are failing. In a quiet cluster even a single failing resource can produce a high ratio, because ASO only re-checks healthy resources periodically; check Azure requests / s for the volume involved.

targets.expr: ((sum(rate(azure_successful_requests_total{job="$job", namespace=~"$namespace", responseCode=~"[45]..", responseCode!="404"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) + (sum(rate(azure_failed_requests_total{job="$job", namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0))) / (sum(rate(azure_requests_time_seconds_count{job="$job", namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: Work queue depth
panels.description: Total number of items waiting to be reconciled. A depth that stays high means ASO is not keeping up.

panels.title: Azure requests / s
panels.description: Rate of requests sent to Azure Resource Manager, including requests that received no response.

panels.title: Azure throttled requests / s
panels.description: Rate of HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests) responses from Azure Resource Manager.

panels.title: Reconcile panics
panels.description: Number of reconciler panics during the selected time range.

panels.title: Reconciles by result
panels.description: Rate of reconciliations, split by result (success, error, requeue, requeue_after).

panels.title: Reconciles by controller (top 10)
panels.description: Controllers doing the most reconciliation work.

panels.title: Reconcile duration
panels.description: Latency percentiles of reconciliations across the selected controllers.

panels.title: Slowest controllers, p95 (top 10)
panels.description: Controllers with the highest 95th percentile reconcile duration.

targets.expr: topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (controller, le) (rate(controller_runtime_reconcile_time_seconds_bucket{job="$job", namespace=~"$namespace", controller=~"$controller"}[$__rate_interval]))) > 0)

panels.title: Reconcile errors returned to controller-runtime (top 10)
panels.description: Errors returned from reconciliation, such as Kubernetes API failures. ASO records most failures, including errors from Azure, on each resource's Ready condition and retries them as requeue_after, so they don't appear here. Use the Azure Resource Manager panels and `kubectl get` to find failing resources.

panels.title: Active workers by controller (top 10)
panels.description: Workers currently reconciling per controller. Each controller can run at most MAX_CONCURRENT_RECONCILES workers (dashed line); a controller that stays at its limit while its queue grows needs more workers.

panels.title: Queue depth by controller (top 10)
panels.description: Items waiting to be reconciled, per controller.

panels.title: Queue wait time, p95 (top 10)
panels.description: How long items wait in the queue before a worker picks them up.

targets.expr: topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (controller, le) (rate(workqueue_queue_duration_seconds_bucket{job="$job", namespace=~"$namespace", controller=~"$controller"}[$__rate_interval]))) > 0)

defaults.noValue: No items processed in this period

panels.title: Retries by controller (top 10)
panels.description: Rate of items requeued with backoff.

panels.title: Longest running reconcile (top 10)
panels.description: How long the longest-running reconcile has been in progress. Steady growth can indicate a stuck worker.

panels.title: Requests by response code
panels.description: Responses received from Azure Resource Manager, split by HTTP status code.

panels.title: Requests by method
panels.description: Requests sent to Azure Resource Manager, split by HTTP method.

panels.title: Request latency by method, p95
panels.description: 95th percentile round-trip time of requests to Azure Resource Manager.

defaults.noValue: No Azure requests in this period

panels.title: Busiest resource types (top 10)
panels.description: Azure resource types with the highest request rate.

panels.title: Throttled requests (429) by resource type
panels.description: Requests rejected by Azure Resource Manager throttling. See the ASO guide on diagnosing Azure throttling.

panels.title: Requests with no response by resource type
panels.description: Requests that failed without receiving a response, for example because of network errors or timeouts.

panels.title: Webhook requests by status code
panels.description: Admission webhook requests handled by ASO, split by HTTP status code.

panels.title: Slowest webhooks, p95 (top 10)
panels.description: Admission webhooks with the highest 95th percentile latency.

defaults.noValue: No webhook requests in this period

panels.title: Webhook requests in flight
panels.description: Admission webhook requests currently being processed.

panels.title: CPU usage
panels.description: CPU used by each ASO controller pod.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Resident memory and Go heap in use for each ASO controller pod.

panels.title: Goroutines
panels.description: Number of goroutines in each ASO controller pod.
